answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 47276 Country: India Title: Suggest a title Question: (1) My name is Arif and I write my name some time MD Arif & some time Mohammad Arif. (2) Please suggest me the meaning of Arif. What is proper way of writing MD Arif/Mohammad Arif or any other way? (3) Also suggest me a good title with a good meaning. Answer ID: 47276 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa; 1376/1049/H=10/1434) (1) You should write complete name i.e. Muhammad Aarif. (2) Aarif means: one who recognizes, and in Islamic terminology it means one who has got the cognizance of Allah and acts upon Shariah in all matters and had high morals. (3) You can take ‘Hassan’ as your title. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
